flagged_canon_discrepancy.description: Vol I 4.1 states the Olympus Spire server hub is where 'Nyx's boss duel takes place.' Volume II's mission-by-mission breakdown and Vol IV's Mission Flow / Character Arc tables contain no Spire-located Nyx encounter. Nyx's confirmed encounters are the Contract 3 subway ambush and the Mission 5 White Zones spare/kill branch.
flagged_canon_discrepancy.recommended_action: Full writing-team review before any Server Hub combat design proceeds. This document builds the space to be architecturally consistent with Vol I's description without committing to a specific resolution.

structural_position.vertical_notes: Canon-explicit, not a new interpretation. Every prior package's vertical position was implicitly measured against this anchor.
structural_position.radial_notes: Canon-explicit (Vol I Ch. 4 preamble). The literal center every other district's radial position was measured as distance from.

sub_locations.notes: Explicitly NOT Dr. Elara Voss's dissident lab, which is a separate buried location per Mission 4.

weave_coverage.note: Not merely maximal like the White Zones or locally-deepened like Metro Archives — this is the point all other Weave coverage in the city originates from.

security_doctrine.canon_line_reused: screens behavior not faces (Undercroft 'The Guest List' connective scene)
security_doctrine.notes: Most sophisticated expression of the same predictive-flagging doctrine (Constraint 6) used citywide.

npcs.notes: Voss's characterization, dialogue, and fate are not extended beyond Vol II Mission 7 and Vol IV Character Arc Summary, per explicit brief instruction.

undercroft.detail: Opposite ends of both radial and vertical axes. Security doctrine line reused verbatim in concept from Undercroft's Guest List scene.

white_zones.detail: Party Level fulfills the social-stealth rehearsal White Zones explicitly set up.

metro_archives.detail: Same proximity-based reality-manipulation rule, narrow/old there vs. broadest/live here.

sector_0.detail: Silence vs. voice, cold vs. warm, dead core vs. live core. Sector 0 document already states it is what this district's core used to be before being superseded.

out_of_scope_flagged.reason: Pending resolution of the flagged Nyx discrepancy (see flagged_canon_discrepancy). Architecture is complete; encounter design is not committed.
